mechanism.name: context-object qualification
mechanism.rule: The register holding the context at the pointer-slot load must be the function's declared context parameter, proven through a conjunction: the entry argument register, whole-register moves with a recursively proven source, and frame-slot reloads whose every reaching store is stack-parameter-proven to the same parameter. Every reaching definition must agree; branches are never unioned into a may-alias.
mechanism.applies_to: the S1 static-table class only, after a dispatch table is found; non-candidates fall through exactly as before
